result.summary: The page is mostly coherent, but the "Fastest near you" carousel has clear alignment/styling inconsistencies between cards, and the favorite (heart) buttons in "Popular right now" are styled inconsistently.

issues.description: In the "Fastest near you" carousel the cards are not aligned on a shared baseline: the middle card (Smash Bros Burgers) image starts ~25px lower than the neighbouring cards, so its title and delivery-fee lines sit below those of the other cards, making the row look jumbled.
issues.suggestion: Give all carousel items a fixed image height and align them to the top of a common flex row so titles and price lines share the same baseline.

issues.description: The first card's image (Green Bowl Poké) renders on a pale gray/white background while the other cards use dark photo-style backgrounds, and its time badge sits at a different vertical offset. It reads as a broken/placeholder image.
issues.suggestion: Use the same image treatment (aspect ratio, background, overlay) for every card and verify the Green Bowl Poké image asset loads correctly; position the duration badge with a consistent bottom-left offset.

issues.description: Favorite heart buttons are inconsistent: the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card shows a plain white outline heart with no background, while the card below has a heart inside a dark circular chip.
issues.suggestion: Standardise the favorite button to one variant (e.g. semi-transparent circular backdrop with white heart) across all restaurant cards for legibility on any image.

issues.description: Secondary text such as "€0.90 delivery", "25–35 min • €0 delivery • Ramen" and the tab labels use light gray on white, which may fall below the 4.5:1 contrast requirement.
issues.suggestion: Darken the muted text color to meet WCAG AA contrast on white backgrounds.
